method.prediction_source: timestamped raw model scores saved before race start
method.model_version_handling: All results are split by the model_version stored in each snapshot; the pooled result is descriptive only and must not be treated as the current model's result.
method.snapshot_archive: GitHub five-minute pre-off archive only; Supabase one-minute rows excluded for reproducibility
method.market_source: win odds and explicit popularity from the same pre-off snapshot
method.snapshot_selection: one closest-to-post valid snapshot per race; no post-off odds
method.formation: deduplicated 2-4-5 3連複, up to 19 unordered combinations
method.narrowing: select 10 of the existing 19 combinations with the lowest sum of LAB (or market) ranks
method.adaptive_rule: narrow to 10 only when LAB top-7 and market top-7 overlap is at least 5; otherwise retain 19
method.same_budget: JPY1900 per race, redistributed in 100-yen units over selected tickets

loader_diagnostics.source: archived five-minute GitHub pre-off snapshots only

divergence_analysis.scope: pooled across model versions; descriptive only

definition.overlap_top7: count of horses shared by LAB top 7 and market top 7
definition.rank_gap: market rank minus LAB rank; positive means LAB ranks the horse higher
definition.horse_outcome: horse appears in at least one official winning 3連複 combination

interpretation: This is a small three-day exploratory sample, not a profitability proof. The pooled result may combine multiple model versions; use results_by_model_version and current_model_results for version-matched interpretation. Compare both actual 100-yen-per-ticket spend and the equal JPY1900-per-race view. Do not promote any strategy to live use from this pilot.
